Introduction

SeoYeon is a South Korean singer and actress under MODHAUS.

SeoYeon was introduced as the first member of the girl group tripleS on May 1, 2022. She made her debut with the first ten members of the group on February 13, 2023, with the mini album "ASSEMBLE".

As a member of tripleS, SeoYeon was placed in the sub-units +(KR)ystal Eyes, ACID EYES, LOVElution and Neptune.

Besides her activities with tripleS, SeoYeon was a contestant on Mnet's survival show "Queendom Puzzle", where she was sadly eliminated after ranking 24th. She also debuted as an actress in September 2024 with her lead role in the web drama 'What Summer Likes!'.
